runes.name: Rune of the Hare
runes.description: Upgrades level of High Card (+10 Coins, +1 Mult)
runes.flavor: Swift and elusive — the hare finds fortune where others see nothing.

runes.name: Rune of the Fox
runes.description: Upgrades level of Pair (+15 Coins, +1 Mult)
runes.flavor: The fox walks in pairs through the world between worlds.

runes.name: Rune of the Otter
runes.description: Upgrades level of Two Pair (+20 Coins, +1 Mult)
runes.flavor: The playful otter speaks of abundance in matched pairs.

runes.name: Rune of the Crow
runes.description: Upgrades level of Three of a Kind (+20 Coins, +2 Mult)
runes.flavor: Three crows speak of power threefold.

runes.name: Rune of the Salmon
runes.description: Upgrades level of Straight (+30 Coins, +3 Mult)
runes.flavor: The salmon runs against the current, unbroken and true.

runes.name: Rune of the Stag
runes.description: Upgrades level of Flush (+15 Coins, +2 Mult)
runes.flavor: The stag in full antler commands the forest of one colour.

runes.name: Rune of the Bear
runes.description: Upgrades level of Full House (+25 Coins, +2 Mult)
runes.flavor: The bear shelters all within its den — a full and mighty house.

runes.name: Rune of the Wolf
runes.description: Upgrades level of Four of a Kind (+30 Coins, +3 Mult)
runes.flavor: The wolf pack hunts in four, its strength multiplied.

runes.name: Rune of the Eagle
runes.description: Upgrades level of Straight Flush (+40 Coins, +4 Mult)
runes.flavor: The eagle soars in one unbroken line above all other creatures.

runes.name: Rune of the Serpent
runes.description: Upgrades level of Royal Flush (+40 Coins, +4 Mult)
runes.flavor: The world-serpent encircles all — crown of the druid's deck.

runes.name: Rune of the Boar
runes.description: Upgrades level of Five of a Kind (+35 Coins, +3 Mult)
runes.flavor: The sacred boar charges without pause — five as one.

runes.name: Rune of the Owl
runes.description: Upgrades level of Flush House (+40 Coins, +4 Mult)
runes.flavor: The owl's wisdom fills every corner of the grove.

runes.name: Rune of the Horse
runes.description: Upgrades level of Flush Five (+50 Coins, +3 Mult)
runes.flavor: The white horse of the gods runs forever at the crest of the wave.

runes.name: Rune of the Knot
runes.description: [Kin] Sets gain +12 Coins and +0.75 Mult per level
runes.flavor: Kinship makes three cards speak as one.

runes.name: Rune of the Path
runes.description: [Road] Runs and Pure Runs gain +10 Coins and +1.5 Mult per level
runes.flavor: Every step teaches the next where to fall.

runes.name: Rune of the Long Weave
runes.description: [Weave] Melds of 5+ gain +8 Coins and +1 Mult per level
runes.flavor: The web grows stronger with every joined strand.

runes.name: Rune of the Wild Host
runes.description: [Weave/Road] Wild melds gain +6 Coins and +1.5 Mult per level
runes.flavor: A stranger at the fire can complete the oldest tale.

runes.name: Rune of the Hand
runes.description: [Bridge] Every scored hand gains +2 Coins and +0.1 Mult per level
runes.flavor: Four held stones and the Turn complete the sign.

runes.name: Rune of Fifteen
runes.description: [Fifteen] Hands with Fifteens gain +8 Coins and +0.4 Mult per level
runes.flavor: Two paths meet at the sacred count.

runes.name: Rune of the Pair
runes.description: [Crib/Peg] Hands with Pairs gain +7 Coins and +0.35 Mult per level
runes.flavor: Matching tracks cross at the barrow gate.

runes.name: Rune of the Little Road
runes.description: [Peg] Hands with Runs gain +9 Coins and +0.5 Mult per level
runes.flavor: Even the shortest road can become a song.

runes.name: Rune of One Blood
runes.description: [Turn] Hands with a Flush gain +15 Coins and +0.75 Mult per level
runes.flavor: Five marks beneath one moon.

runes.name: Rune of the Peg
runes.description: [Peg] Books that score pegging gain +8 Coins and +0.3 Mult per level
runes.flavor: The hare remembers every count on the road to thirty-one.

runes.name: Rune of the Crib
runes.description: [Crib] Double Books gain +12 Coins and +0.5 Mult per level
runes.flavor: What was buried in Books 1 and 2 returns in Book 3.
